title: Positive categorical Cech exactness passes through a simultaneous affine etale presentation
statement: Let Y be a scheme, V a pro-etale Y-object, U a finite family over V, and S an AffineEtaleCechSystem for U indexed by a small cofiltered category I [def-cbc-affine-etale-cech-system]. Let A be Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] and J an A-valued sheaf on Y_et. Assume every S.nerveCone is a limit after forgetting to schemes. If the categorical finite Cech complex of J at each etale stage is exact at q+1, then the categorical finite Cech complex of the comparison pullback of J on the original family U is exact at q+1 [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

source.place: Lemma 61.19.4, the two finite Cech limit reductions; categorical extension via AB5.

proof.text: For each nerve term apply the already proved categorical comparison continuity API AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.isColimit_comparisonUpperStar_mapCocone_of_isAffine from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.Comparison.Continuity. Its cocone maps are the restrictions along S.π. Naturality of S.π and S.π_face imply compatibility with the alternating differential. Construct the complex diagram and its original-complex cocone.
In each degree commute the filtered colimit with the finite product, using exactness of filtered colimits. The products of the component section cocones are therefore colimiting.

Transpose three consecutive degrees into a short complex in a functor category. Use the existing upstream ShortComplex.exact_iff_evaluation to prove its exactness objectwise. Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.colim.exact_mapShortComplex to the three degreewise colimits, obtaining exactness of the original complex.
